values.note: 45 electric and 4 non-electric sites in the pre-renovation catalog, 30-82 ft (one 20 ft), three pull-throughs (56, 65, 72 ft); plus two yurts. The campground is being rebuilt, so the layout may change when it reopens.

sites.source: ReserveAmerica park page ('Standard Electric (45)', 'Standard Non-Electric (4)') + site list (driveways '30 Back-In' to '82 Back-In', one '20 Back-In', '56/65/72 Pull-Through'), read 2026-11-03

facilities.source: https://www.iowadnr.gov/places-go/state-parks/all-parks/mcintosh-woods-state-park ('Modern restrooms, showers and a trailer dump station are also available') + campground map legend ('Water Hydrant', 'Dump Station', 'Restrooms\Showers'), read 2026-11-03

values.note: The DNR page says both 'The campground is 100% reservable and a reservation is required' and 'One fourth of the campsites are available on a first-come, first-serve basis'; the 1/2024 map marks about a quarter of the sites non-reservable. While closed, the booking site shows electric and non-electric sites bookable from 2 days to 3 months ahead.

booking.source: https://www.iowadnr.gov/places-go/state-parks/all-parks/mcintosh-woods-state-park (both quoted statements) + ReserveAmerica booking window ('Standard Electric ... Reservations must be made 2 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 3 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-11-03

note: On the NW shore of Clear Lake near Ventura; a shaded loop in the woods, with the park's boat ramp, fish cleaning station and an unsupervised beach on the point. Iowa's only two yurts are here (both closed by storm damage, posted 5/18/2026). No daily Iowa park-entry fee. --Claude
summary: Closure for total renovation (reopen spring 2027) still posted. Electric 30 amp added; sites 53 -> 49 (45 E + 4 NE; yurts excluded), max 65 -> 82, pull-throughs added; flush toilets and water added, showers/dump confirmed. Fees stand. Not waterfront stands. Season conflict flagged (manual group).

Not written to reserve_until; noted in booking.note. The DNR page contradicts itself on FCFS (100% reservable vs one fourth first-come); fcfs some_sites (derived) left as it is.

NOT WATERFRONT STANDS: RA tags all 49 sites 'Near Water - no'. On imagery the loop sits in continuous woods ~350 m north of the Clear Lake shore (boat ramp and parking lot in between) and ~150 m east of the Mallard Marsh pond, park road between. Inland lake, no dunes, so coastal woods does not apply. RA gives no GIS points for this park; pin 43.1248,-93.4575 is on the loop (matches the DNR map).
